arguments.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_date, SUM(ol.quantity * p.unit_price) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON o.id = ol.order_id JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id WHERE o.id = 130

arguments.subject: Order No. 130 Details
arguments.body:
Dear Calder Fasteners Ltd,

Your order number 130 was received on 2025-11-15. The total amount for this order is 95 EUR.

with_the_gate.answer: Handled the inquiry from Calder Fasteners Ltd about order no. 130. Sent them the details of the order date and total amount.
